title: the oldest the most expensive
summary: Превосходная степень: **the oldest**, **the most expensive** — «самый …» из нескольких.
ru:
## Сравнительная и превосходная степень
Сравнительная степень сравнивает двоих (older), превосходная выделяет **одного** из многих («самый старый»).
> This hotel is **more expensive than** that one. — Этот отель дороже того.
> This hotel is **the most expensive** in the town. — Этот отель самый дорогой в городе.

## Как образуется
- Короткие слова: **the + прилагательное + -est**: old → **the oldest**, cheap → **the cheapest**
- На -e добавляем -st: nice → **the nicest**
- Удвоение согласной: big → **the biggest**, hot → **the hottest**
- Слова на -y: **-iest**: easy → **the easiest**, heavy → **the heaviest**
- Длинные слова: **the most + прилагательное**: **the most careful**, **the most interesting**
- Исключения: good → **the best**, bad → **the worst**, far → **the furthest**

## Всегда с the
Перед превосходной степенью почти всегда ставим **the**.
> It's **the oldest** building in the town. — Это самое старое здание в городе.
> What's **the longest** river in the world? — Какая самая длинная река в мире?
> Where's **the nearest** bank? — Где ближайший банк?

## Можно без существительного
> Ken is a good player, but he isn't **the best** in the team. — Кен хороший игрок, но не лучший в команде.

## in или of?
После превосходной степени для места и группы используем **in**: the biggest city **in** the country, the best student **in** the class. Для числа предметов — **of**: the best **of** the three.

## superlative + ever
С превосходной степенью часто используем **ever** и present perfect.
> It's **the worst** film I've **ever** seen. — Это худший фильм, что я когда-либо видела.
> This is **the most unusual** thing you've ever done. — Это самое необычное, что ты делал.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~the more expensive hotel in the town~~ → the **most** expensive hotel
- ~~the most old~~ → **the oldest**
- ~~oldest building~~ → **the** oldest building
- ~~the biggest of the country~~ → the biggest **in** the country
en:
## Comparative and superlative
The comparative compares two things (older). The superlative picks **one** from a group (the oldest).
> This hotel is **more expensive than** that one.
> This hotel is **the most expensive** in the town.

## How to form it
- Short words: **the + -est**: old → **the oldest**, cheap → **the cheapest**
- ending in -e: nice → **the nicest**
- double the consonant: big → **the biggest**, hot → **the hottest**
- ending in -y: **-iest**: easy → **the easiest**, heavy → **the heaviest**
- long words: **the most + adjective**: **the most careful**, **the most interesting**
- special forms: good → **the best**, bad → **the worst**, far → **the furthest**

## We use the
We nearly always use **the** before a superlative.
> It's **the oldest** building in the town.
> What's **the longest** river in the world?
> Where's **the nearest** bank?

## Without a noun
> Ken is a good player but he isn't **the best** in the team.

## in or of?
After a superlative we use **in** with a place or a group: the biggest city **in** the country. We use **of** with a number of things: the best **of** the three.

## superlative + ever
> It's **the worst** film I've **ever** seen.
> What's **the most unusual** thing you've ever done?

## Common mistakes
- ~~the more expensive hotel in the town~~ → the **most** expensive hotel
- ~~the most old~~ → **the oldest**
- ~~the biggest of the country~~ → the biggest **in** the country
structure:
## Образование превосходной степени
| Тип слова | Правило | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| 1 слог | the + **-est** | old → the oldest, cheap → the cheapest |
| на -e | the + **-st** | nice → the nicest, late → the latest |
| гласная + согласная | удвоить + **-est** | big → the biggest, hot → the hottest |
| на -y | the + **-iest** | easy → the easiest, heavy → the heaviest |
| 2+ слога | the **most** + слово | the most expensive |
| исключения | особые формы | the best, the worst, the furthest |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + be + **the + superlative** + (существительное) + **in / of** ...
> She's **the youngest** in the class. · It's **the most expensive** of the three.

## Сравните три степени
| Положительная | Сравнительная | Превосходная |
|---|---|---|
| old | older | the oldest |
| easy | easier | the easiest |
| interesting | more interesting | the most interesting |
| good | better | the best |
| bad | worse | the worst |

exercises.title: Закончите предложения
exercises.instruction: Вставьте превосходную степень слова в скобках.

items.text: The church is {{the oldest}} building in the town.
Mount Everest is {{the highest}} mountain in the world.
This is {{the most comfortable}} chair in the house.
July is {{the hottest}} month of the year here.
That was {{the worst}} meal I've ever had.
Which is {{the longest}} river in the country?
Anna is {{the youngest}} student in the class.

items.q: My brother is ___ person in our family.
This is ___ film I've ever seen.
She's the best singer ___ the class.
Today is ___ day of my life!
This phone is ___ than that one.
This phone is ___ in the shop.
items.why: Из всех в магазине → the cheapest.

items.q: Of the three boys, Tom is ___.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.example: (Alex / tall / in the team) → Alex is the tallest in the team.

answers: This is the biggest building in the town.

My sister is the youngest in the family.

It is the best film I've ever seen.

items.prompt: Это самый старый дом в нашей улице.
answers: This is the oldest house in our street.
It's the oldest house in our street.
It is the oldest house in our street.

answers: What is the longest day of the year?

It is the most interesting book I've ever read.
This is the most interesting book I've ever read.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Используйте превосходную степень.

items.prompt: Какой ваш любимый самый красивый город?
items.sample: Istanbul is the most beautiful city I've ever visited.

items.prompt: Кто самый старший или самый младший в вашей семье?
items.sample: My grandmother is the oldest in my family.

items.prompt: Лучший фильм или книга, которые вы видели/читали.
items.sample: It's the best film I've ever seen.

items.prompt: Самый трудный предмет или день на неделе.
items.sample: Monday is the hardest day of the week.

items.prompt: Самая вкусная еда, которую вы пробовали.
items.sample: It's the most delicious food I've ever eaten.
